title: kate-text: match angle brackets
summary: matching_bracket pairs < with >. Nested brackets still match. A quote stays unmatched. The test goes in the existing brackets tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: brackets.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change PAIRS from three pairs to four. The fourth pair is < and >. The array length is 4. Leave the scan functions unchanged. A quote is still not a bracket. Parentheses, square brackets, and curly brackets stay as they are. The test angle_brackets_match uses a<b>. Offset 1 returns Some offset 3. Offset 3 returns Some offset 1. The text <<>> matches offset 0 to offset 3 and offset 1 to offset 2. The text a < b at the < returns None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: brackets::tests::angle_brackets_match
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because < is not a bracket and matching_bracket returns None. After the change a<b> matches offset 1 with offset 3. <<>> matches the outer pair at 0 and 3 and the inner pair at 1 and 2. a < b returns None.
